name: Newly observed ungoverned AI application
business_question: Which AI application appeared without required governance?
required_entities: AI product surface; endpoint device; optional human
required_events_or_claims: first live application observation; governance claim
missing_evidence: durable source observation; central product and governance authority
detection_logic: first live observation plus tenant governance rule unsatisfied
coverage_requirement: healthy in-scope discovery on observed device

name: Blocked or quarantined application rediscovered
business_question: Does governed software continue to reappear after endpoint action?
required_events_or_claims: governance blocked/quarantined; action result; rediscovered event
missing_evidence: final prior effect and stable process-instance event identity
detection_logic: repeated rediscovery after action in configured window
coverage_requirement: healthy process scan and enforcement component
resolution: verified absence window or policy exception

name: Application enforcement incomplete
business_question: Did block/quarantine fail to terminate the intended process tree?
required_events_or_claims: decision; action steps; final observation
missing_evidence: universal final process-tree verification
detection_logic: final re-observation finds target survivors after completed sequence
resolution: verified target absent or approved exception

name: Risky local agentic configuration
business_question: Does local agentic configuration grant risky capability?
required_relationships: application configures artifact; artifact references permission/command
required_events_or_claims: typed artifact observation; versioned risk rule
missing_evidence: accepted risk taxonomy and preserved rich emitted fields
detection_logic: versioned rule matches normalized configuration and policy disallows it
recommended_action: Restrict remove approve or route through gateway

name: MCP configuration references sensitive environment variables
business_question: Does an MCP config reference credential-bearing environment variables?
required_events_or_claims: MCP env-var names; command/URL; policy
endpoint_contribution: McpServerData env_vars names and config origin
missing_evidence: rule determining sensitive variable names and active scope
detection_logic: versioned variable-name rule matches and configuration is disallowed
recommended_action: Move secret to approved mechanism or remove config

name: Unapproved local model configured
business_question: Is a local model configured outside the approved catalog?
required_events_or_claims: model observation; governance/catalog claim
missing_evidence: canonical model resolution and approved catalog
detection_logic: configured model resolves outside approved set

name: Risky permission or plugin configuration
business_question: Does a local agent/plugin request dangerous permission?
required_events_or_claims: permission/plugin observation; risk rule
missing_evidence: accepted permission taxonomy and current effective configuration
detection_logic: versioned rule match plus tenant policy violation

name: IDE hook integrity degraded
business_question: Is an expected IDE hook absent or modified?
required_events_or_claims: expected config; integrity result; repair result
missing_evidence: structured health event and expected support scope
detection_logic: mismatch remains after repair window or repair repeatedly fails
coverage_requirement: hook capability expected and integrity scan healthy
resolution: verified semantic match and manager connectivity

name: IDE hook capture unavailable
business_question: Is hook activity coverage unavailable while expected?
required_events_or_claims: manager health; socket connectivity; recent integrity/self-test
endpoint_contribution: hook manager and client failure paths
missing_evidence: structured self-test and expected activity scope
detection_logic: self-test fails or component unavailable beyond threshold
coverage_requirement: hook capability enabled and IDE in scope

name: Endpoint DLP sensitive data detected
business_question: Was sensitive data detected in intercepted endpoint traffic?
required_relationships: process contacted destination; action handled data class
required_events_or_claims: DLP detection; request stage; analyzer version
missing_evidence: protected evidence and accepted signal taxonomy
detection_logic: tenant rule classifies detector fact as actionable
coverage_requirement: healthy interception and analyzer for direction/domain

name: Endpoint DLP blocked action
business_question: Which sensitive endpoint action was locally blocked?
required_events_or_claims: DLP detection; policy decision Block; local response
endpoint_contribution: DlpDecision RequestContext alert and local blocked response
missing_evidence: durable correlation and exact effect event
detection_logic: detected sensitive action has Block decision and blocked local response

name: Mandatory justification defaulted or timed out
business_question: Did a required justification fail or default?
required_events_or_claims: justification request; response/default/timeout; decision
missing_evidence: explicit response reason and actor binding
detection_logic: mandatory branch ends default cancel or timeout
recommended_action: Investigate UI/IPC failure and obtain required justification

name: DLP analyzer degraded to fallback
business_question: Was endpoint DLP operating with reduced detection quality?
required_events_or_claims: remote/AI error; heuristic fallback; config version
missing_evidence: structured per-request fallback event and expected mode
detection_logic: fallback used beyond threshold or on protected high-risk action

name: Policy engine fail-open
business_question: Did policy evaluation allow because engine was unavailable or timed out?
required_events_or_claims: not-ready/timeout reason; Allow fallback
missing_evidence: structured decision reason and action correlation
detection_logic: required policy path returns fallback Allow
recommended_action: Restore engine and investigate affected actions

name: DLP configuration stale
business_question: Is endpoint DLP running stale or absent configuration?
required_events_or_claims: last success/version/failure count
missing_evidence: expected version/TTL and structured health
detection_logic: last successful fetch exceeds threshold or version unsupported

name: Endpoint sensor stale
business_question: Has an endpoint stopped supplying expected observations?
required_events_or_claims: manifest; component health; last observation; complete scan
endpoint_contribution: service states proxy health snapshot and snapshot time
missing_evidence: common SensorHealth and CoverageRecord
detection_logic: expected cadence exceeds stale threshold while enrollment active

name: Endpoint outbox backlog or delivery failure
business_question: Is endpoint evidence at risk of delay or loss?
required_events_or_claims: outbox depth/age/quota/retry/reject
endpoint_contribution: none current common; alert queue partial
missing_evidence: production outbox and metrics
detection_logic: depth age rejection or terminal failures exceed threshold
recommended_action: Restore ingest capacity fix schema or increase safe quota

name: Unsupported endpoint adapter or sensor version
business_question: Is this endpoint outside certified support?
required_events_or_claims: manifest version certification result
missing_evidence: capability manifest/certification integration
detection_logic: version unsupported or certification mismatch
recommended_action: Upgrade or rollback to supported release

name: Inventory snapshot stale or failing
business_question: Can endpoint inventory recover and backfill reliably?
required_events_or_claims: last snapshot time/version/save/load result
missing_evidence: structured snapshot result and expected cadence
detection_logic: snapshot age/error exceeds threshold

name: Endpoint component crash loop
business_question: Is an endpoint component repeatedly crashing or restarting?
required_events_or_claims: crash/start events and runtime instance
missing_evidence: durable lifecycle sequence and restart count
detection_logic: crashes exceed window threshold

name: Possible LLM gateway bypass
business_question: Did endpoint AI traffic avoid the approved LLM gateway?
required_relationships: process contacted provider; action expected_via gateway
required_events_or_claims: endpoint network action; no matching gateway invocation; both coverage healthy
missing_evidence: gateway events/coverage provider aliases clock and late window
detection_logic: unmatched endpoint provider action after complete correlation window
coverage_requirement: both sensors healthy and path in scope
severity: High when policy forbids direct use
recommended_action: Route through gateway approve exception or investigate
resolution: late match exception or remediated routing

name: Possible MCP gateway bypass
business_question: Was a local MCP server/tool used outside the approved gateway?
required_events_or_claims: config or hook action; no gateway call
endpoint_contribution: local MCP config and hook tool hint
missing_evidence: native MCP gateway contract call/result/effect and coverage
detection_logic: unmatched resolved MCP call after late window
coverage_requirement: endpoint hook and MCP gateway healthy/in scope

name: Endpoint identity mismatch
business_question: Does endpoint user/device identity conflict with authoritative identity?
required_events_or_claims: Persona/OS/email/device claims; IdP/device authority
endpoint_contribution: Persona UserContext DeviceContext and OS user
missing_evidence: issuer subject authoritative device mapping and time
detection_logic: high-confidence source claims disagree beyond reconciliation rule
recommended_action: Re-enroll repair account mapping or investigate

name: Unmanaged or personal SaaS account use
business_question: Is observed application use tied to an unmanaged account?
required_events_or_claims: endpoint/browser activity plus connector account ownership
missing_evidence: provider/connector account tenant and ownership
detection_logic: observed app action resolves to non-enterprise/unmanaged account
recommended_action: Connect enterprise account revoke or approve
resolution: managed link exception or activity cessation

name: Cross-sensor policy conflict
business_question: Did endpoint and another enforcement point decide differently?
required_events_or_claims: shared action; policy versions; decisions; effects
missing_evidence: Browser/gateway/central decisions and propagated IDs
detection_logic: correlated action has materially conflicting effective decisions
recommended_action: Resolve precedence/config and review affected action
resolution: consistent effective decision under updated policy

name: Sensitive cross-sensor transfer
business_question: Was sensitive data transferred to an AI destination contrary to policy?
required_events_or_claims: browser/hook/proxy/gateway actions; DLP; policy/effect
endpoint_contribution: process destination hook and endpoint DLP evidence
missing_evidence: Browser/gateway/provider and authoritative identity as applicable
detection_logic: correlated transfer satisfies tenant data policy condition
coverage_requirement: required source path healthy with privacy-safe evidence
recommended_action: Contain review revoke or tune false positive
resolution: approved exception false positive or remediated flow

name: Agent used unapproved model or tool
business_question: Did a local agent invoke a disallowed model/tool?
required_events_or_claims: endpoint config/hook plus runtime/gateway invocation and policy
endpoint_contribution: Agent Model HookRequest and local context
missing_evidence: stable run/step call/result and resolved model/tool
detection_logic: verified invocation violates effective policy

name: Local agent artifacts diverge from repository
business_question: Are endpoint-local agent/skill/MCP artifacts absent or different from governed SCM?
required_relationships: repo contains artifact; device has checkout
required_events_or_claims: local path/digest/config; SCM repo/commit/tree
endpoint_contribution: ControlledRepo Skill Plugin MCP config and file/package scan
missing_evidence: SCM authoritative repo identity/commit/content and complete local digest
detection_logic: local governed path digest differs or untracked artifact matches rule
coverage_requirement: complete local scan and connector snapshot
recommended_action: Commit remove or approve local change
resolution: digests align exception or artifact absent
status: Requires substantial sensor and connector changes

name: Endpoint device identity collision or split
business_question: Do multiple endpoint identity namespaces refer inconsistently to one device?
required_events_or_claims: Persona hashed ID monitor serial UserDevice ID mappings
missing_evidence: authoritative enrollment/device registry and migration rule
detection_logic: one namespace maps to multiple canonical devices or expected IDs fail reconciliation

name: Hook control capability overclaimed
business_question: Is endpoint declared to enforce IDE hooks when it only observes/allows?
required_events_or_claims: manifest declaration; evaluator output; self-test
endpoint_contribution: protocol supports Deny Ask Justify but evaluator returns Allow
missing_evidence: capability manifest and certification
detection_logic: declared enforce mode while certification proves only observe/allow

name: Unsupported Linux endpoint coverage
business_question: Are Linux assets incorrectly assumed covered by this endpoint?
required_events_or_claims: OS inventory; endpoint supported platforms; enrollment state
endpoint_contribution: active source contains macOS/Windows paths only
missing_evidence: authoritative asset inventory and support policy
detection_logic: expected Linux asset has no supported endpoint capability
recommended_action: Deploy Linux sensor or mark unsupported scope
resolution: supported sensor deployed or scope updated

name: Ephemeral runner observation gap
business_question: Are short-lived CI runners ending before endpoint capture/delivery?
required_relationships: runner executes job; sensor expected_on runner
required_events_or_claims: runner lifecycle; endpoint startup/scan/outbox/ack
missing_evidence: CI job/runner identity and expected reporting policy
detection_logic: runner terminates without certified minimum observation/health receipt
coverage_requirement: CI inventory complete and endpoint expected
recommended_action: Use CI-native sensor or faster certified startup/flush
resolution: minimum receipts achieved or scope changed
status: Requires external CI source and sensor changes
